messages:
Alex Chen: heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4187 is ready for merge. It's a small hotfix that restores the model cache warmup flow that regressed in last deploy. Can @infra-oncall and @Mina Patel please eyeball eviction/batching impacts before we merge?
Mina Patel: thanks Alex. quick skim looks fine but want infra to confirm there won't be a spike in mem pressure with the new prefetch loop. can we run the canary at low qps first? :eyes:
Alex Chen: yep planning a staged canary: 5% for 10m, then 25% for 20m, then full. command i'll run locally:```bash
git checkout pr/4187 && ./scripts/deploy-canary --percent=5 --duration=10m
```
Sam Rodriguez: tagging @Ravi K. for security check on the new env var change (MODEL_PREFETCH_ENABLED). it's harmless but we changed how the service reads KMS-wrapped cache keys.
Ravi K.: I can look in ~30m. superficially it's ok but need to confirm no new IAM role allowed. if it's only toggling behavior, low risk. pls paste the diff for the env change.
Alex Chen: diff snippet:```diff
- CACHE_PREFETCH=false
+ CACHE_PREFETCH=true
+ MODEL_PREFETCH_ENABLED=true
```
Mina Patel: infra-oncall — can you run a quick mem profile in staging after canary at 5%? if RSS jumps >20% abort. also check eviction rate and kv-hit ratio.
infra-oncall: on it. i'll schedule a staging run in 10min and share metrics. if anything spikes i'll DM for rollback.
merge-bot: deployment checklist: ci: ✅ unit tests, ✅ integration smoke, flaky-tests: 2 warnings, e2e: running. suggested wait for e2e pass before merging.
Sam Rodriguez: if e2e takes too long we can do manual canary and monitor dashboards. i'm okay to approve once infra and sec sign off.
Ravi K.: quick note — ensure the KMS call is retried with idempotency so we don't double-init cache on partial failures. otherwise :+1:.
Alex Chen: good catch, added a retry with backoff in the diff. small change, pushed to branch. link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4187
Mina Patel: LGTM from platform perspective pending infra metrics. :thumbsup:
infra-oncall: staging run complete. mem +10%, eviction rate normal, kv-hit ratio improved by 8%. no anomalies in logs. i'll mark infra +1 in the PR.
Ravi K.: security looked at auth scope for the KMS call; no new permissions required. sec-bot marks sec +1.
Sam Rodriguez: thanks everyone. Alex — once e2e passes or you opt for manual canary, ping me and i'll queue merge window at 3pm PST.
Alex Chen: will do. plan: wait for e2e (expected in ~15m), then manual canary per plan, ping Sam for merge window. appreciate the fast turnaround! :rocket:
